settings.title: Settings
settings.host_helper: Public host name Plex is published on. It must resolve to this server.
settings.network_mode_helper: Bridge: only the web/API port is published and fronted by Traefik (recommended). Host: Plex binds 32400 and the GDM/DLNA discovery ports directly on the node — LAN clients find the server automatically; only one such instance per node.
settings.media_paths_helper: Absolute paths on this node, e.g. the iSCSI disk or NFS shares mounted by the host. Each is mounted read-only at the same path inside the container — pick the same paths as on a previous Plex host to keep an existing library.
settings.media_hint_title: Prepare the paths on the node
settings.media_hint_desc: Mount the disk/share on the node first (fstab with _netdev and, for SELinux, context="system_u:object_r:container_file_t:s0"). Files must be world-readable (chmod -R o+rX) because the rootless container sees foreign owners as 'nobody'. See the README.
settings.claimed_title: Server '{name}' is linked to a Plex account
settings.claimed_desc: Plex Media Server {version}. Manage libraries and users in the Plex web interface.
settings.unclaimed_title: Server not yet linked to a Plex account
settings.unclaimed_desc: Get a claim token at https://www.plex.tv/claim, paste it below and save within 4 minutes. The server is then linked to your account at the next start.
settings.plex_claim_helper: One-time token from https://www.plex.tv/claim (valid 4 minutes). Not stored after use.
settings.web_url_desc: Open Plex in the browser at {url}
settings.proxy_hint_desc: After linking, open Settings → Network in Plex and check 'Custom server access URLs' contains https://{host}:443 (set automatically) and 'Secure connections' is 'Preferred'. Then add libraries pointing at the media paths above.
settings.domain_already_used_in_traefik: This host name is already used by another instance.
settings.media_path_invalid: Media paths must be absolute and must not contain spaces, commas or colons
settings.media_path_missing: Media path does not exist on the node
settings.media_path_unreadable: Media path is not readable by the module user — chmod o+rx
settings.media_path_not_mounted: Media path is not on a mounted filesystem — mount the disk/share first or disable 'Require mounted filesystem'
settings.port_32400_in_use: Port 32400 is already in use on this node (another Plex instance in host mode?)
settings.no_dri_device: No /dev/dri device on this node — hardware transcoding is not available
